pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, predominantly sub-polygonal dark brown regions. Edge gradients are mostly smooth with minor pixel-level serrations. Spatial area is maximal on the mid-flank and neck, transitioning to smaller, more condensed geometries on the posterior and lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous lattice of light-tan negative space. Pathways exhibit variable thickness, being widest between the larger mid-body patches. The network is defined by high-connectivity nodes, primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck presents a distinct, high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background, composed of short, upright hair fibers.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A prominent, localized region of textural disruption and de-pigmentation is visible on the upper posterior flank/lower back, appearing as an irregular white-grey patch that breaks the standard pelage pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregularly shaped de-pigmented lesion with altered surface texture is present on the upper flank. This feature lacks the dark pigmentation of standard patches and disrupts the local corridor network.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct pendulous skin fold or localized swelling is visible on the ventral midline, positioned posterior to the foreleg junction.
